about_short_description.short_description: Together Video Chat is a video chat app designed for children-grandparent interaction and offers playful and educational activities.

product.name: Together Video Chat App
product.description: A video chat application designed for children and their long-distance grandparents to interact through video calls and shared activities.

product.name: Pre-installed Children's Book Library
product.description: A collection of children's books integrated into the app for reading during video calls, allowing users to point and interact with the book pages.

product.name: Book Scanning Feature
product.description: A tool within the app that allows users to scan physical books and add them to their personal digital library for use during video calls.

product.name: PDF Upload Feature
product.description: Allows users to upload PDF files of books to their personal library for reading during video calls within the app.

product.name: Frog Math Game
product.description: An interactive math game where two players solve equations collaboratively to move a frog across logs safely.

product.name: Gummy Blocks Game
product.description: A collaborative spatial game where players take turns placing blocks to clear rows and columns on a shared board.
